title: Room Backup
description:
Save and remount Habbo room layouts (floor + wall), including stacked heights with Magic Stack Tile and furniture states.

Place missing items aside first, then remount with stackmagic. Walls use G-BuildTools-style moves.

Open snapshots folder from the UI (Folder button) or :mfolder.

Inspired by G-Presets and G-BuildTools.

Tested on Habbo ES - should work on other hotels G-Earth supports. Large rooms: merges multi-packet Objects/Items (Magic Stack Tiles are intentionally not saved).
